math-failure.label: the share of math courses failed

nonmath-failure.label: the share of nonmath core courses failed

interpretations.math: This supports the paper's finding that tutoring improved mathematics outcomes.
interpretations.reading: The paper did not establish a clear improvement in reading-test scores.
interpretations.study1Nonmath: This supports the paper's finding of improved nonmath course performance in Study 1.
interpretations.study1Behavior: The authors did not detect behavioral spillovers; the imprecision does not establish that tutoring has no effect.
interpretations.study2Nonmath: The authors found no statistically significant nonmath spillovers in Study 2 after multiple-testing adjustment.
interpretations.study2Behavior: The authors found no statistically significant behavioral spillovers in Study 2 after multiple-testing adjustment.

interpretationSource: Guryan et al. (2023), main-results discussion, printed pp. 748–750, especially p. 749
policy: Claims must state the source-backed finding and its meaning in the visible title and at most two concise description sentences. Titles may express fractions in percentage points as a unit conversion only; structured values stay unchanged. Source-row q-values are not relabeled as estimand-specific p-values. Unknown units remain explicit.
